title: TCG: Scarlet & Violet 151
description: A celebration of the original 151 Kanto Pokémon!

questions.question: What is the central theme of the 151 set?
questions.explanation: Pokémon 151 celebrates the original Kanto Pokédex from Red & Blue.

questions.question: When was Pokémon 151 released in English?
questions.explanation: Pokémon 151 launched in English on September 22, 2023.

questions.question: All 151 original Kanto Pokémon appear in this set.
questions.explanation: Every single one of the original Kanto Pokémon, from Bulbasaur to Mew, is featured.

questions.question: Which legendary Pokémon serves as the chase Special Illustration Rare?
questions.explanation: Mew ex's Special Illustration Rare became one of the most sought-after cards.

questions.question: Pokémon 151 was originally a Japan-exclusive set before its English release.
questions.explanation: The set debuted in Japan as 'Pokémon Card 151' before releasing internationally.

questions.question: Which trio of legendaries from Kanto appears as ex cards?
questions.explanation: The legendary bird trio of Kanto all appear as ex cards.

questions.question: Which starter ex from the set saw heavy competitive play?

options.text: All starters appear as ex cards

questions.explanation: Venusaur ex, Charizard ex, and Blastoise ex all appear as ex cards in the set.

questions.question: 151 product was notoriously difficult to find at retail due to its popularity.
questions.explanation: Demand for 151 product caused massive shortages and scalping at launch.

questions.question: How many cards are in the 151 set (including secret rares)?
questions.explanation: Pokémon 151 has 207 cards including secret rares.

questions.question: The Ultra Premium Collection for 151 features a metal Mew card.
questions.explanation: The 151 UPC includes special metal Mew and Mewtwo cards as exclusive collectibles.
